text:
ashwin: quick brain-dump: proposing a "tenant quarantine" mode in the prefix/kvcache stack to reduce eviction oscillation for very hot tenants. short-lived, local-only tweak to scoring + admission.

lina: neat. goal metric? fewer cross-tenant rehydrates / tail spikes?

dash: exactly. reduce churn that causes cascading rehydrates and penalizes neighbors. also surface a signal for backpressure.

ashwin: rough behavior: detect when tenant.eviction_rate and rehydrate_rate exceed thresholds over a sliding window -> set tenant.quarantine for QUARANTINE_WINDOW. Quarantined prefixes get boosted residency score, lower prefetch concurrency, and an admit token bucket.

dave: pseudocode for detection and scoring:
```
if tenant.eviction_rate > E && tenant.rehydrate_rate > R:
  tenant.quarantine_until = now + Q_WINDOW

score = base_score(prefix)
if tenant.quarantine_until > now:
  score += QUARANTINE_BOOST
  score = min(score, MAX_SCORE)
```

lina: correctness question: do we change leases/ownership? can quarantine cause split-brain ownership assumptions?

dash: quarantine must not touch lease tokens or ownership. purely local scoring/admission. ownership & handoff invariants unchanged.

sophia: op/observability: we need events and traces to avoid hiding fairness regressions.

ashwin: plan: emit enter/exit events, tag fills with quarantine=true, record admit_count, prefill_rate, eviction_delta, rehydrate_latencies. gauge for quarantine_active_tenants.

dave: rollout: start in read-only mode (compute candidates), then 5% node pilot. compare fairness_score and P95/P99 tail. back out if regressions.

sre-bot: note: read-only run showed ~12 candidates in last 24h on cluster-prod-gpu-3. scheduling 5% pilot tomorrow 04:00 UTC.

lina: edge-case: customers that are themselves multi-tenant (many small prefixes)  we should aggregate hotness at tenant-level, not only per-prefix, and avoid starving tiny hotspots.

dash: agreed. prefer tenant-level quarantine but allow per-prefix override for tiny noisy prefixes.

sophia: ops controls? force-enter/force-exit and opt-out for enterprise?

ashwin: yes: admin knobs behind RBAC feature-flag: force-enter, force-exit, tenant-opt-out. document in runbook.

dave: resource accounting: quarantined prefixes will hold memory longer. implement a soft separate budget pool and throttle admits when pool depleted so we don't starve others.

lina: I'll run the offline cache simulator with real traces and add dashboards: quarantine owners, fairness delta, admitted rate, tail-latency diff.

ashwin: action items:
- dave: add decision hook + scoring change, small prototype branch
- lina: simulator runs + dashboards + runbook
- sophia: admin UX + RBAC draft
- ops: canary 5% nodes + kill switch

sophia: add unit tests asserting no ownership/lease mutation when scoring path runs.

ashwin: will include tests. opening prototype PR tomorrow unless objections. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: update: pilot started cluster-prod-gpu-3 at 2026-03-24T04:00:00Z (coverage=5%), quarantine_active_tenants=1.
